Runtime budget (host-enforced; you cannot raise it):
- wall clock: task work stops about 29m 59s from now (total run budget 30m 00s); queue, model, and tool time all count against it.

There is no cumulative token cap and no automatic compaction in this runtime: a single step billing over 100000 input tokens ends the run with a hand-back report, so keep turns focused instead of accumulating unbounded history. When a limit is reached, task work stops where it stands and only a small reserved hand-back turn remains to report it.
